entries.title: Self-building core, not the full app
entries.text: This codebase is RARE's development engine. Future RARE features are capabilities built by it, not hand-added to the core.

entries.title: Mandatory change sequence
entries.text: Understand -> Plan -> Check risk -> Approve if necessary -> Snapshot -> Modify -> Validate -> Repair -> Accept/Rollback.

entries.title: Provider independence
entries.text: No code outside rare_core/reasoning/providers may reference a specific AI provider. Local/free/self-hostable first.

entries.title: Local-first, offline tolerant
entries.text: Basic self-development must work without internet; degrade gracefully when a model or tool is unavailable.

entries.title: Standard library only
entries.text: Core code uses only the Python 3.9+ standard library so it runs on Windows, Android (Termux/Pydroid) and can be packaged as EXE/APK.

entries.title: Typed, explicit, structured errors
entries.text: Use type hints, dataclasses, explicit interfaces and RareError subclasses; no hidden global state; no giant modules.

entries.title: Capabilities layout
entries.text: capabilities/<id>/ with capability.json, __init__.py, core.py and tests/ (unittest).

entries.title: Paths are POSIX and project-relative
entries.text: Every stored path uses forward slashes relative to the project root so state can move between PC and phone.

entries.title: Bootstrap and recovery are protected
entries.text: rare_core/bootstrap/ and rare_recovery.py start the system and restore checkpoints; the engine may never modify them.

entries.title: Dependencies need approval
entries.text: Adding a third-party dependency is a medium-risk action requiring approval and must not break Android/EXE packaging.

entries.title: No shell, no secrets in logs
entries.text: Commands run as argv lists from an allow-list, never via a shell; secrets are redacted and scrubbed from child processes.

entries.title: Models propose, users authorise
entries.text: Risk is derived from concrete paths/commands; only user channels hold approval authority.

entries.title: Nothing is done until validated
entries.text: A change is accepted only after its checks pass; untested changes are checkpointed as experimental, never known-good.

entries.title: Run the checks
entries.text: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .  and  python -m rare_core selftest

entries.title: Future packaging
entries.text: Keep core logic separate from platform adapters, UI, storage and integrations so the same engine can ship in Windows EXE and Android APK.
